0.en: It was March fifth, in the year twenty-one ten.
0.id: Hari itu tanggal lima Maret, tahun dua ribu seratus sepuluh.

1.en: It was almost eleven at night on a remote island somewhere in the Atlantic Ocean. The island stretched roughly fifty-six kilometers across, about thirty-five miles from one side to the other, but most of it remained undeveloped wilderness. Near its center sat a research settlement of laboratories, homes, workshops, medical facilities, and other buildings supporting the nearly five hundred people who lived there.
1.id: Saat itu hampir pukul sebelas malam di sebuah pulau terpencil di suatu tempat di Samudra Atlantik. Pulau itu membentang kira-kira lima puluh enam kilometer, sekitar tiga puluh lima mil dari satu sisi ke sisi lainnya, tetapi sebagian besar wilayahnya masih berupa alam liar yang belum terjamah. Di dekat pusatnya berdiri sebuah permukiman riset berisi laboratorium, rumah, bengkel, fasilitas medis, dan bangunan-bangunan lain yang menopang hidup hampir lima ratus orang yang tinggal di sana.

2.en: Deep inside one of those laboratories, Dr. Jack Bennett was hard at work. Technically.
2.id: Jauh di dalam salah satu laboratorium itu, Dr. Jack Bennett sedang bekerja keras. Secara teknis.

3.en: Jack sat slumped in his chair with his arms folded across his chest, his head tilted toward one shoulder, and several pages of diagnostic data glowing on the monitor in front of him. His eyes were closed.
3.id: Jack duduk merosot di kursinya dengan kedua lengan terlipat di dada dan kepala miring ke satu bahu, sementara beberapa halaman data diagnostik menyala di monitor di hadapannya. Matanya terpejam.

4.en: A warning tone chirped from Jack's console. He shifted but did not wake. A second tone followed, louder than the first, and the diagnostic display flashed amber.
4.id: Sebuah nada peringatan berbunyi dari konsol Jack. Ia bergeser sedikit, tetapi tidak terbangun. Nada kedua menyusul, lebih keras dari yang pertama, dan layar diagnostik berkedip kuning.

6.en: Jack jerked awake so quickly that his chair rolled backward and nearly struck another workstation.
6.id: Jack tersentak bangun begitu cepat sampai kursinya meluncur mundur dan nyaris menabrak meja kerja lain.

8.en: The warning repeated while Jack rubbed his eyes and leaned toward the monitor.
8.id: Peringatan itu terulang, sementara Jack mengucek mata dan mencondongkan badan ke arah monitor.

10.en: Several windows were opening and closing on their own. Lines of commands streamed across one side of the display faster than he could read them. Jack grabbed the keyboard and opened the network monitor.
10.id: Beberapa jendela membuka dan menutup dengan sendirinya. Baris-baris perintah mengalir di satu sisi layar, lebih cepat daripada yang sanggup ia baca. Jack meraih keyboard dan membuka monitor jaringan.

11.en: Come on. What are you doing?

12.en: An unfamiliar connection appeared for half a second and vanished.
12.id: Sebuah koneksi asing muncul selama setengah detik, lalu lenyap.

15.en: He refreshed the display, but the connection was gone. Another warning tone sounded from the console and a red message filled the center of his screen.
15.id: Ia memuat ulang tampilan, tetapi koneksi itu sudah hilang. Nada peringatan lain berbunyi dari konsol, dan sebuah pesan merah memenuhi bagian tengah layarnya.

17.id: Oke. Sekarang aku benar-benar sudah bangun.

18.en: Jack entered a command and pulled up the laboratory access logs. Nothing looked unusual. He tried another search and got the same result.
18.id: Jack memasukkan sebuah perintah dan membuka log akses laboratorium. Tidak ada yang tampak janggal. Ia mencoba pencarian lain, dan hasilnya tetap sama.

20.en: The system beeped, and a directory opened by itself. Jack stopped typing when he recognized the folder.
20.id: Sistem berbunyi bip, dan sebuah direktori terbuka dengan sendirinya. Jack berhenti mengetik begitu mengenali folder itu.

23.en: He immediately locked the terminal. The screen went black for three seconds, then came back on and reopened the same directory.
23.id: Ia langsung mengunci terminal. Layar menghitam selama tiga detik, lalu menyala kembali dan membuka direktori yang sama.

31.en: Sarah's voice came through the speaker.
31.id: Suara Sarah terdengar lewat pengeras suara.

33.en: I've got something weird on my computer. It tripped a security alarm.
33.id: Ada yang aneh di komputerku. Sampai memicu alarm keamanan.

34.en: Sarah leaned closer to the intercom.

37.en: I think somebody's in the system.
37.id: Sepertinya ada yang masuk ke sistem.

40.en: Jack scanned the empty connection list.
40.id: Jack memindai daftar koneksi yang kosong.

41.en: No. That's why I'm calling the smarter scientist.
41.id: Tidak. Makanya aku memanggil ilmuwan yang lebih pintar.

42.en: Sarah laughed softly through the speaker.
42.id: Sarah tertawa pelan lewat pengeras suara.

45.en: Can you come take a look?
45.id: Bisa ke sini dan lihat sebentar?

47.en: Jack released the intercom and looked back at the monitor. The TOMBS directory was still open.
47.id: Jack melepaskan tombol interkom dan kembali menatap monitor. Direktori TOMBS masih terbuka.

49.en: The cursor moved without him touching anything.
49.id: Kursor bergerak padahal ia tidak menyentuh apa pun.

50.en: Jack froze as a file opened.
50.id: Jack membeku saat sebuah file terbuka.

53.en: He reached for the keyboard just as the laboratory door slid open behind him.
53.id: Ia meraih keyboard tepat ketika pintu laboratorium bergeser terbuka di belakangnya.

54.en: Sarah Bennett walked straight in, tablet tucked beneath one arm, already crossing toward him. She glanced from Jack to the computer.
54.id: Sarah Bennett langsung masuk dengan tablet terselip di bawah satu lengan, dan sudah melangkah ke arahnya. Pandangannya beralih dari Jack ke komputer.

55.en: Please tell me you didn't break something.
55.id: Tolong bilang kamu tidak merusak apa-apa.

57.en: Sarah closed the distance between them.

58.en: You called me in here to admit that?
58.id: Kamu memanggilku ke sini cuma untuk mengaku itu?

59.id: Jack memberi isyarat ke arah konsol.

64.en: Whatever this is. I was reviewing yesterday's test results.
64.id: Atas apa pun ini. Aku sedang meninjau hasil uji kemarin.

72.en: She leaned over his shoulder and studied the screen.
72.id: Sarah membungkuk di atas bahu Jack dan mengamati layar.

74.en: Jack straightened in his chair while Sarah placed her tablet beside the keyboard.
74.id: Jack menegakkan duduknya sementara Sarah meletakkan tabletnya di samping keyboard.

75.en: Right. Problem. I got an unauthorized access warning. I checked the network monitor and saw a connection I didn't recognize, but it disappeared before I could trace it.
75.id: Oke. Masalahnya. Aku dapat peringatan akses tanpa izin. Aku cek monitor jaringan dan melihat koneksi yang tidak kukenali, tapi koneksi itu hilang sebelum sempat kulacak.

76.en: Sarah tapped the edge of the keyboard.

78.en: Jack pointed to the open directory.

83.en: Sarah looked at the terminal lock indicator.

91.en: Sarah stared at him for a moment before looking back at the monitor. Jack pointed at the screen.
91.id: Sarah menatapnya sejenak sebelum kembali melihat monitor. Jack menunjuk layar.

93.en: Sarah started powering up the other console next to Jack.
93.id: Sarah mulai menyalakan konsol lain di samping Jack.

95.en: Jack kept one hand on the keyboard.
95.id: Satu tangan Jack tetap di atas keyboard.

97.en: Sarah nudged the arm of his chair, looking slightly annoyed, but sympathetic.
97.id: Sarah menyenggol sandaran lengan kursinya, tampak agak kesal, tetapi tetap maklum.

98.en: Let me have your chair and get another chair.
98.id: Biar aku pakai kursimu, kamu ambil kursi lain.

99.en: Jack gave Sarah his chair right away.
99.id: Jack langsung memberikan kursinya kepada Sarah.

100.en: Oh. Of course. Anything for you.
100.id: Oh. Tentu saja. Apa pun untukmu.

101.en: He crossed to the next workstation and dragged its chair back, wheels squeaking against the floor, before pulling himself up to his own screen.
101.id: Ia pindah ke meja kerja sebelah dan menarik kursinya, rodanya berdecit di lantai, lalu merapat ke layarnya sendiri.

104.en: Jack watched his own log scroll.
104.id: Jack memperhatikan log di layarnya bergulir.

106.en: Sarah opened the connection history on her screen.
106.id: Sarah membuka riwayat koneksi di layarnya.

114.en: He pulled up the TOMBS directory again, tracing back through what had changed.
114.id: Ia membuka lagi direktori TOMBS, menelusuri kembali apa saja yang telah berubah.

115.en: Sarah kept scanning her own feed.

117.en: Jack pointed at his own screen.

118.en: Mine too. Whoever it was covered both trails.
118.id: Punyaku juga. Siapa pun itu, dia menghapus jejak di keduanya.

119.en: Sarah narrowed her eyes at the display.

126.en: Sarah shook her head, but Jack caught the beginning of a smile. He glanced at the time and then at her.
126.id: Sarah menggeleng, tetapi Jack sempat menangkap senyum yang mulai muncul di wajahnya. Ia melirik jam, lalu menatap Sarah.

127.en: You know, you're supposed to be resting.

131.id: Aku kan bukan yang sedang hamil.

133.en: No. You're the one I found asleep at a laboratory terminal.
133.id: Memang bukan. Kamu yang kudapati tertidur di depan terminal laboratorium.

136.en: Sarah stopped typing long enough to look at him.
136.id: Sarah berhenti mengetik sejenak untuk menatapnya.

140.en: Sarah gave him a look that answered the question for him.
140.id: Sarah memberinya tatapan yang sudah menjawab pertanyaan itu.

141.en: Jack surrendered with a small nod.

143.en: Sarah rested a hand briefly against her stomach.
143.id: Sarah menaruh tangannya sebentar di perutnya.

144.en: Lately the baby seems to think eleven at night is morning.
144.id: Belakangan ini si bayi sepertinya mengira jam sebelas malam itu pagi.

146.en: Jack smiled at the movement beneath her hand.
146.id: Jack tersenyum melihat gerakan di bawah telapak tangan Sarah.

150.en: A new warning tone interrupted them. Both turned toward the main console as another message appeared.
150.id: Sebuah nada peringatan baru menyela mereka. Keduanya menoleh ke konsol utama saat pesan lain muncul.

151.id: Permintaan inisialisasi jarak jauh Array TOMBS.

158.en: Jack reached across the console and rejected the request.
158.id: Jack menjangkau ke seberang konsol dan menolak permintaan itu.

164.en: He entered his administrator credentials, but a new message appeared before he could issue another command.
164.id: Ia memasukkan kredensial administratornya, tetapi sebuah pesan baru muncul sebelum ia sempat memberikan perintah lain.

166.en: Sarah looked from the message to him.
166.id: Pandangan Sarah beralih dari pesan itu ke Jack.
